def find_Volume(base, triangle_height, prism_length):
    """
    Calculate the volume of a triangular prism.
    
    Parameters:
        base (float or int): Base length of the triangular face
        triangle_height (float or int): Height corresponding to the base
        prism_length (float or int): Length/height of the prism
    
    Returns:
        float: Volume of the triangular prism
    """
    area_of_triangle = 0.5 * base * triangle_height
    volume = area_of_triangle * prism_length
    return volume

# Test assertion
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert find_Volume(10, 8, 6) == 240
    print("All tests passed!")

def find_Volume(base, triangle_height, prism_length):
    """
    Calculate the volume of a triangular prism.
    
    Parameters:
        base (float or int): Base length of the triangular face
        triangle_height (float or int): Height corresponding to the base
        prism_length (float or int): Length/height of the prism
    
    Returns:
        float: Volume of the triangular prism
    """
    area_of_triangle = 0.5 * base * triangle_height
    volume = area_of_triangle * prism_length
    return volume

# Test assertion
assert find_Volume(10, 8, 6) == 240
print("All tests passed!")
